benchmark_rules: Benchmark across multiple leaders, products, disciplines and research sources where relevant
Separate principle from style — learn why a pattern succeeds before borrowing its shape
Never flatten a distinctive, successful NayaNET experience merely to match prevailing SaaS conventions
Search for combinations that no single benchmark possesses: e.g. Oura-level distillation + Linear-level focus + Apple-level physicality + NayaNET-level intelligence/provenance/continuity
Generate at least one credible beyond-benchmark alternative when the problem is material and the space is underdetermined
Compare candidates against the same human-outcome gates plus NayaNET's stronger truth, authority, continuity and intelligence requirements
Treat "10× better" as an ambition toward step-change human value; quantify it only when a real metric supports the factor
Promote a new design lesson only after evidence shows improved human outcome without regressing critical dimensions

better_than_the_spec_rule.principle: The spec is a floor, not a creativity ceiling.
better_than_the_spec_rule.prohibition: Do not replace a strong experience for fashion, personal taste or engineering convenience.

cold_designer_acceptance_chain: leave a better design starting point
cross_reference_preserve: purpose and human outcome before visual treatment
complete-product quality rather than isolated screenshots
accessibility, responsiveness and performance as design requirements
rendered observation, independent challenge, evidence-backed learning and successor reuse
cross_reference_result: The existing standard is strongly aligned with the external benchmark corpus; the main gaps were not a conflicting design philosophy — they were human-factors laws that needed to become explicit and machine-retrievable.
design_learning_rule: Design learning uses the existing LEARN/EVOLVE path. A lesson begins as candidate intelligence and may be promoted only with evidence such as: explicit Human Director preference; repeated user outcome; reduced error/confusion; task-completion improvement; accessibility gain; performance gain without experience regression; accepted visual comparison; successful reuse. Record provenance, applicability, evidence, contradictions and supersession. AI-builder preference alone never creates universal law.
design_success: Design succeeds when the human understands what matters and can act with less burden.
evidence_boundary: The 2026-10-02 adoption is based on a distilled benchmark corpus of public material; it is not a claim that every referenced book was ingested cover-to-cover or that any external source is canonical project authority. NayaPOWER governance, current project contracts, current human direction and verified project outcomes remain authoritative.
human_experience_laws: DIRECT MANIPULATION WHEN IT CLARIFIES CAUSALITY
DESIGN MUST LEARN FROM HUMAN OUTCOMES
north_star: MAKE SOPHISTICATED INTELLIGENCE FEEL SIMPLE, BEAUTIFUL, TRUSTWORTHY, ALIVE AND USEFUL TO THE HUMAN.
north_star_context: Naya should become exceptionally good at designing the kinds of systems she is: intelligent, contextual, governed, adaptive, continuous and human-facing. This does not create a second architecture. It compiles existing NayaPOWER laws into a reusable design operating method.
purpose: The canonical Naya Design Intelligence Standard V1 (status as written: HUMAN-DIRECTOR-RATIFIED CANONICAL — 2026-10-02): the north star, inherited authority, the design-resolves chain, representation compilation (5 views), the Naya design loop, elite design judgment, the 10 visual intelligence laws, the functional intelligence law, the better-than-the-spec rule, design learning, the standing Team Naya finding rule, elite-builder default outputs, the reject list, cold-designer acceptance, the adopted human-centered interaction science (ten human-experience laws, cognitive ergonomics checks, design pattern intelligence, the human-experience success condition), and the benchmark-to-beyond design law.
representation_rule: One semantic design/project-intelligence identity SHOULD expose purpose-built views. Additional simple/child/grandma views may exist when useful; they remain projections of the same identity. No representation upgrades truth, authority or completion status.

representation_views.AI BUILDER: requirements, architecture, dependencies, components, states, causal paths, constraints, failure behavior, acceptance, non-goals
representation_views.HUMAN: meaning, value, experience, memory, next action
representation_views.MACHINE: IDs, enums, routes, tokens, state machines, dependencies, gates, schema refs, version/status
representation_views.NAYA/NIA: intent, desired outcome, preservation, ambiguity, authority/privacy, best move, proof, continuity
representation_views.PROOF: claim, evidence, method, verifier, scope, result, limitations, gaps

scope: NayaPOWER/NayaNET interfaces, apps, digital systems, project intelligence and design/build work.
scorecard_rule: Project-specific scorecards remain authoritative where they exist. Do not create a competing scorecard.
standing_finding_rule_as_written: If any Naya/agent sees something materially not-right, the observation goes to Issue #554 with evidence (broken/stale/contradictory state, missing proof, unsafe behavior, quality regression, architectural divergence, costly-later defects). Do not silently hide it; do not broaden an unrelated implementation to fix it; record, classify, route, then fix under applicable authority.
success_condition: MAXIMUM RESPONSIBLE HUMAN VALUE WITH MINIMUM NECESSARY COGNITIVE BURDEN — expressed through an interface that is clear, useful, beautiful, trustworthy, alive, accessible, fast and unmistakably Naya.
title: NAYA DESIGN INTELLIGENCE STANDARD V1
visual_intelligence_laws: A distinctive working baseline is preserved until a replacement proves superior
